# 2025 World Seniors Championship

## Lead Section

The 2025 World Seniors Championship was a prestigious snooker tournament held at the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield, England from May 7 to 11, 2025 . The event featured 16 players aged 40 and over from nine nations competing for the title of world seniors champion . Alfie Burden from England emerged victorious, defeating Aaron Canavan from Jersey 8-4 in the final . The tournament was sponsored by JenningsBet and was broadcast live on Channel 5 and 5Action in the UK .

## Event Details

### Venue and Format

The 2025 World Seniors Championship took place at the Crucible Theatre, snooker's most iconic venue, which is traditionally used for the World Snooker Championship . The tournament format consisted of 16 players competing in a knockout system with the following structure: first round and quarter-final matches were contested over the best of five frames, semi-finals were best of seven frames, and the final was best of nine frames .

### Participants

The international field of 16 players included defending champion Igor Figueiredo from Brazil, who was eliminated in the first round . Other notable participants included four-time champion Jimmy White from England, former world champion Ken Doherty from Ireland, and Maltese legend Tony Drago . The field also featured recently retired professional players such as Dominic Dale and Joe Perry .

## Competition Results

### Early Rounds

The tournament began with the first round on May 7, where several upsets occurred. Defending champion Igor Figueiredo was defeated 2-4 by English amateur Wayne Townsend in a surprising first-round exit . Jimmy White, the four-time winner, was eliminated 1-4 by Alfie Burden, marking a repeat of their 2023 final . Ken Doherty also suffered an early exit, losing 2-4 to South African player Charl Jönk .

### Quarter-finals and Semi-finals

In the quarter-finals, Alfie Burden faced Tony Drago and came back from a 3-0 deficit to win 4-3, demonstrating his fighting qualities . Aaron Canavan defeated Dominic Dale in another quarter-final match, setting up a semi-final meeting with Burden . The semi-finals saw Burden defeat Australian debutant Hassan Kerde 6-2, while Canavan stunned Dominic Dale to reach the final .

### Final

The championship final took place on May 11 and was split into three mini-sessions of five frames each . The match began with a moment of history as Michaela Tabb, the first female referee to officiate a World Snooker Championship final in 2009, took charge of her final frames at the Crucible Theatre .

Canavan broke the deadlock, but Burden quickly hit back to take four successive frames, with contributions of 74 and 54, to lead 4-1 at the first break . Canavan reduced the deficit with a break of 75, but Burden showed his scoring prowess with consecutive breaks of 65, 109, and 80 to move to 7-2 .

Canavan managed to win frames 10 and 11 to make the score 7-4, but Burden remained composed. In the title-winning frame, Burden fired in a flamboyant break of 76 to secure an 8-4 victory . After the match, Burden expressed his delight, saying: "I'm absolutely delighted. I thought I played well in the final. It's been a massive journey with so many ups and downs... It was a strong field this week and I felt like I played the best snooker and deserved to win the tournament" .

## Prize Money

The total prize fund for the 2025 World Seniors Championship was £50,000, with the winner receiving £20,000 and the runner-up £10,000 . Additionally, there was a £1,500 prize for the highest break of the tournament .

## Historical Context

The World Seniors Championship has a long history in snooker, having been first held in 1991 . The tournament is the world's premier snooker competition for players aged 40 or over . The event was initially held at Trentham Gardens in Stoke-on-Trent, with Cliff Wilson defeating Eddie Charlton 5-4 to become the inaugural champion .

The tournament was discontinued after 1992 but was revived in 2010 in Bradford with a reduced field of nine players . Since then, it has been held annually, with the venue and format evolving over time. The minimum age requirement has varied, starting at 40 in 1991, increasing to 45 in 2011, and returning to 40 in 2015 .

From 2019 onwards, the tournament has been held at the Crucible Theatre immediately following the World Snooker Championship . The winner of the World Seniors Championship receives a place in the Champion of Champions tournament, provided they are not already qualified through other means .

## Notable Performances

### Alfie Burden's Victory

Alfie Burden's victory in the 2025 World Seniors Championship was particularly significant as it was his first title in the event . The 48-year-old had previously lost to Jimmy White in the 2023 final . Burden qualified for the tournament through the Golden Ticket Play-Off, defeating Matthew Ford 4-3 in April 2025 . His path to victory included wins over Jimmy White, Tony Drago, Hassan Kerde, and finally Aaron Canavan in the final .

### Michaela Tabb's Farewell

The final match was also notable for marking the retirement of referee Michaela Tabb, who had been officiating at the Crucible Theatre for many years . Tabb made history in 2009 as the first female referee to take charge of a World Snooker Championship final, and the 2025 World Seniors Championship final was her last at the iconic venue .

## Broadcast and Media Coverage

The 2025 World Seniors Championship was broadcast live on Channel 5 and 5Action in the UK . The tournament was also available to watch via the WPBSA SnookerScores platform . The event received significant media coverage, particularly in snooker-specific publications and websites .

## Legacy

The 2025 World Seniors Championship continued the tradition of providing a platform for veteran snooker players to compete at the highest level. The tournament showcased the skill and experience of players who may have retired from professional competition but still possess significant talent . The event also served as a reminder of the rich history of snooker and the contributions of its veteran players.

Alfie Burden's victory established him as the new champion in seniors snooker, while the tournament overall highlighted the continued popularity and competitiveness of the World Seniors Championship format . The event remains an important part of the snooker calendar, providing entertainment for fans and opportunities for veteran players to continue their careers in a competitive setting.

Die **World Seniors Championship** ist ein Einladungsturnier für Senioren.

Erstmals ausgetragen wurde es 1991 in [Stoke-on-Trent](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stoke-on-Trent "Stoke-on-Trent"). Nach fast 20 Jahren gab es im November 2010 eine Neuauflage in [Bradford](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bradford "Bradford"). Bei beiden Veranstaltungen galt ein Mindestalter von 40 Jahren. Für die dritte Auflage 2011 in [Peterborough](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peterborough "Peterborough") wurde das Mindestalter auf 45 Jahre angehoben. Für die sechste Auflage 2015 in [Blackpool](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blackpool "Blackpool") wurde das Mindestalter wieder auf 40 Jahre gesenkt.

Bis 2016 war die Veranstaltung Bestandteil des Turnierkalenders der [Snooker Main Tour](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snooker_Main_Tour "Snooker Main Tour"). Nach Auslaufen des bis dahin geschlossenen Ausrichtervertrags wurde das Turnier 2017 für zwei Jahre zu einem reinen Amateurturnier ohne Profibeteiligung. Ab 2019 fand das Turnier jeweils im Anschluss an die [Profiweltmeisterschaft](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snookerweltmeisterschaft "Snookerweltmeisterschaft") im [Crucible Theatre](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crucible_Theatre "Crucible Theatre") in [Sheffield](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sheffield "Sheffield") statt.

Der Sieger der World Seniors Championship kann außerdem als Nachrücker für das [Champion of Champions](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Champion_of_Champions "Champion of Champions") berücksichtigt werden, wobei die Sieger der Turniere der [Profitour](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Snooker_Tour "World Snooker Tour") Vorrang haben. Ab 2019 nahmen alle Seniorenweltmeister an dem Turnier teil.

11.content:
世界元老锦标赛，算不算斯诺克职业赛？【附元老赛海报收藏】_腾讯新闻
===============

世界元老锦标赛，算不算斯诺克职业赛？【附元老赛海报收藏】
============================

![Image 1: 头像](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_ls/0/13214633189_200200/0)![Image 2: A gold badge with a white outline and a white checkmark in the center](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_ls/0/14876048581/0)

[交叉小径的花园](https://news.qq.com/omn/author/8QMf13pY6YUbvDs%3D)
2022-07-04 08:35 发布于 上海 体育领域创作者

![Image 3: Claret Jug sits atop a black and gold base with the flags of Scotland and England blurred in the background](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063224444/641)

（世界元老锦标赛奖杯。图片转自世界斯诺克WST官网。）

本来没有计划做斯诺克世界元老锦标赛（World Seniors Championship，以下简称元老世锦赛或元老赛）的资料。但是在编纂个别球员职业赛资料时，元老世锦赛是不是斯诺克职业赛事，成了一个麻烦且又绕不过去的的问题。所以本文结合这个问题，简单整理了一些元老赛的资料。

![Image 4: Stephen Hendry holding a trophy with smile](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063224852/641)（2019年元老赛夺冠的怀特）

一、元老世锦赛的基本资料图

![Image 5: Table representing a list of World Seniors Championship snooker tournament results from 1991 to 2022, including the year, winner, runner-up, score, prize money, age restriction, number of professional players/total, organizer, and nature of the competition](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063227209/641)

说明：

元老世锦赛的参赛门槛多有变化，打底年满40岁，多个年份超过45岁；2022年元老赛，年龄门槛又回到40岁后，但加了一个限制条件，如果是职业球员，其世界排名需在65位以后。

2015年赛期由上半程转到下半程，故2014年无元老赛。

![Image 6: Jimmy White holds the 2024 World Seniors Snooker Championship trophy](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063227819/641)（2020年元老赛夺冠的怀特）

二、元老世锦赛的性质

![Image 7: A table shows the World Senior Championship tournaments from 1991 to 2022, with their status and category](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063228918/641)（cuetracker的定性）

关于职业赛的标准问题，没有明确的标准。

参阅：斯诺克赛事分类和斯诺克数据统计相关问题

此处讨论元老赛的性质问题，我们主要参考两个资料来源，英文版维基百科和cuetracker网站。分四部分讨论。

1. 1991年

当时参赛的16位球员，14位老将，包括当时年龄最大的埃迪-查尔顿（62岁），当时都是，职业身份。两位非职业球员是赛会邀请的，一位是印度著名比利球员迈克尔-费雷拉（Michael Ferreira），另一位是美国著名美式台球球员迈克-梅西（Mike Massey）。

这届赛事，两网均定为职业赛。无异议。

![Image 8: Snooker players promotion banner for 888sport World Seniors Snooker Championship on January 30 & 31, 2016 in Preston Guildhall](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063229348/641)

（2016年海报。包括之前年份的海报，都挂着世界斯诺克WPBSA的LOGO。）

2. 2010-2016年

这段期间的元老世锦赛，都是在世界斯诺克（WPBSA）直接管辖下，赛事也挂在世界斯诺克职业巡回赛的赛程下。但职业球员的参赛比例，尤其是门槛过45岁那段期间，是很低的。

两网均定为职业赛事。其中最主要原因，赛事主办方是WPBSA。

个人，其实对这段期间的元老赛定为职业赛，是持相当的保留意见的。个人以为，除了1991年元老世锦赛，其他各系列的元老赛，均倾向于定为非职业赛。但鉴于两网意见一致，个人尊重定2010-2016元老世锦赛定为职业赛。。

3. 2017-2018年

这两年的赛事，交由Snooker Legends组织。Snooker Legends以组织表演赛出名。参赛者均为业余球员，排除职业球员参加。

这两年的元老赛，维基定为元老邀请赛（invitational senior snooker tournament），未加职业赛一词。但维基在编纂2017年冠军彼得-莱恩斯的资料时，却把2017年的元老赛冠军，划在了莱恩斯职业赛的冠军里。而cuetracker，未收录这两届赛事。难道cuetracker定为表演赛？一堆人参加的赛事，冠军还能获得参加世界锦标赛资格赛的席位，算个业余赛事不为过。

定性，业余赛事（非职业赛）。

![Image 9: John Higgins is holding the trophy while smiling and wearing a black vest](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230073/641)

![Image 10: Man holding a snooker world championship trophy, smiling in front of the audience](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230075/641)

（2021年冠军大卫-利利，和2022年冠军李-沃克。图片均转自于世界斯诺克WST官网。）

4. 2019-2022年

元老世锦赛又重归WPBSA掌控，不过元老赛没有挂在斯诺克世界职业巡回赛的赛历里，斯诺克世界职业巡回赛的主导权也已经不在WPBSA手里。元老世锦赛属于WPBSA掌管的元老巡回赛（World Seniors Tour）的一部分。[1]

对于这一段，也是非常混乱的。cuetracker定为职业-业余混合赛，也就是非职业赛。而维基的定性前后矛盾颇多。在具体介绍每一届赛事时，多用业余赛事定性[2]；但是在相关介绍，有时又会说是职业赛事，特别是在这几届冠军的个人资料里，维基又把元老赛冠军算在球员的职业赛冠军里。这也是我之前在另文里谈到的，维基掌握职业赛的尺度较宽松，且任意性很大。

个人意见，采纳cuetracker的意见，定为职业-业余混合赛（非职业赛）。

附几届元老世锦赛的海报：

![Image 11: World Seniors Snooker Championship logo with a vest and bow tie icon at the top](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230886/641)

![Image 12: The poster for the World Seniors Snooker Championship of November 5th and 6th 2011, being held at The Atrium, East of England Showground, Peterborough](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230890/641)

![Image 13: World Seniors Snooker Championship poster featuring images of four snooker players in suits standing around a snooker table](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230887/641)

![Image 14: The poster announces the World Seniors Snooker Championship, Winning Still Matters, on October 27 & 28, 2012 at the Mountbatten Centre, Portsmouth](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230889/641)

![Image 15: Betway World Seniors Snooker Championship promotion in Circus Arena, the Blackpool Tower during 2-3 March 2015](http://inews.gtimg.com/newsapp_bt/0/15063230891/641)

注：

[1] Snooker Legends和WPBSA也是有密切关系的。而元老巡回赛开始也是由Snooker Legends设立的。个中关系，具体怎样，不清楚。

[2] The 2020 World Seniors Championship was an amateur snooker tournament that……

微信公众号：交叉斯诺克。

The World Seniors Championship is an invitational seniors snooker tournament which has been played under different formats. As of 2020 the minimum age is 40, but it was 45 in 2011 and 2012. History The event was first held in 1991 with 16 players aged over 40. It took place at the Trentham Gardens in Stoke-on-Trent with the sponsorship of Matchroom. The final was contested between the two highest ranked players, with Cliff Wilson defeating Eddie Charlton 5–4 to become the inaugural champion. The event was revived in 2010, but the field was reduced to 9 players and was played in Bradford. The event was sponsored by Wyldecrest Park Homes, who remained the sponsor until 2012. In 2011 event the minimum age for competitors was increased from 40 to 45 years, and it was moved to the East of England Showground in Peterborough. All matches were best of 3 frames, a 30-second shot clock was introduced after ten minutes of play, and the miss rule was altered so was awarded anyw ... The 2010 World Seniors Championship (known for sponsorship reasons as the Wyldecrest Park Homes World Seniors Championship) was a snooker tournament that took place between 5–7 November 2010 at the Cedar Court Hotel in Bradford, England. The event had last been held in 1991, when Cliff Wilson won in the final 5–4 against Eddie Charlton, to become the inaugural champion. Jimmy White won in the 2010 final 4–1 against Steve Davis and claimed his 30th career title. It is the main settlement in the Borough of Blackpool, borough of the same name. Blackpool was originally a small hamlet; it began to grow in the mid-eighteenth century, when sea bathing for health purposes became fashionable. Blackpool's beach was suitable for this activity, and by 1781 several hotels had been built. Alfie Burden Secures Crucible Spot
==================================

22nd April 2025

[Home](https://wpbsa.com/) » Alfie Burden Secures Crucible Spot

**Alfie Burden defeated Matthew Ford 4-3 in the Golden Ticket Play-Off to secure the final place at the 2025 JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship.**

*   [Results](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-golden-ticket/knockout)

The 48-year-old Englishman will face Jimmy White at the Crucible Theatre in a repeat of the 2023 World Seniors Snooker Championship final after coming through a field of 16 players in Reading last weekend.

The Play-Off line-up was made up top eight ranked players who did not qualify automatically for the flagship event in each of the official two-year world ranking list and the one-year ‘Race to the Crucible Series’ ranking list.

Burden had missed out on an automatic place at the Championship by just a single frame in the concluding qualification event of the season but bounced back in the Golden Ticket Play-Off event.

![Image 5: Two men, one bald and dressed in a black button-up shirt and pants, the other wearing a vest over a white dress shirt, shake hands in front of a black backdrop with the Jennings Bet logo printed many times](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/FordBurden-300x225.jpg)

Victories over Andy Lavin (4-2), Irish former professional Rodney Goggins (4-1) and Stuart Watson (4-1) saw Burden book his place in the final where he faced compatriot Ford.

The 49-year-old had dropped just three frames in as many matches en route to the final and a break of 67 in frame five put Ford just one away from victory and a Crucible debut.

Burden refused to be beaten, however, forcing a decider before getting over the line by a 78-46 scoreline to complete the victory and earn a return to snooker’s most iconic venue.

[**Tickets remain available for the World Seniors Championship and start from just £17.50.**](https://www.sheffieldtheatres.co.uk/events/world-seniors-snooker-championship-2025)

Roll of Honour
==============

**First held in 1991, the World Seniors Championship is the world's premier snooker tournament for snooker players aged 40 or over.**

Since 2017, the tournament has formed part of the World Seniors Snooker Tour, with both icons of the sport and amateur qualifiers among those to contest the title.

Alfie Burden Wins 2025 JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship
=====================================================================

12th May 2025

[Home](https://wpbsa.com/) » Alfie Burden Wins 2025 JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship

**Alfie Burden is the 2025 JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker champion after he defeated Aaron Canavan 8-4 at the Crucible Theatre on Sunday.**

*   [Results](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025/results)

The 48-year-old, who was the last player to qualify for the event via the Golden Ticket Play-Off last month, came through a strong field at the sport’s most famous venue to lift the most prestigious title in seniors snooker for the first time.

![Image 10: A man in black suit raises a trophy above his head in front of crowd](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/D52_2336-300x200.jpg)

Burden’s campaign began with a repeat of the 2023 World Seniors Snooker Championship final and he exacted revenge on four-time winner Jimmy White, before showing his fighting qualities from 3-0 down against Maltese legend Tony Drago to advance to the semi-finals.

A comfortable 6-2 victory over Australian debutant Hassan Kerde then set up a title match meeting with 2018 champion Aaron Canavan from Jersey after he stunned Dominic Dale in the last four.

![Image 11: Two men in suits standing on either side of a woman in a suit, all three in front of a snooker table with balls on it and a trophy](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/NZ9_0003-300x200.jpg)

The best-of-15 frame final was split into three mini-sessions of five frames and the first of these saw a moment of history as Michaela Tabb, who became the first female referee to take charge of a World Snooker Championship final in 2009, took charge of her final frames at the Crucible Theatre.

It was Canavan who broke the deadlock but the Englishman quickly hit back to take four successive frames, with help from contributions of 74 and 54, to lead 4-1 at the first break.

![Image 12: A snooker player in a black suit leans over a green snooker table, aiming to hit the cue ball, with an audience in the background](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/NZ9_0086-300x200.jpg)

A 75 saw the cueist from Jersey reduce the deficit before Burden once again showed off his scoring prowess by hit consecutive breaks 65, 109 and 80 to move one away from victory at 7-2.

Canavan was able to avoid defeat before the second interval as he took frame 10 and further threatened a comeback by taking the next to put the scoreline at 7-4.

![Image 13: A man playing snooker with an audience in the background](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/NZ9_0029-300x200.jpg)

Burden admitted afterwards that, even at 7-3 ahead, he had told his coach Patsy Fagan that he “wasn’t fancying winning” but there were few signs of nerves in the title-winning frame as he fired in a flamboyant break of 76 to get over the line as an 8-4 victor.

![Image 14: Snooker player Mark Allen poses with a trophy and two people, in front of an audience and a snooker table](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/D52_2318-300x200.jpg)

Following the victory, Burden said: “I’m absolutely delighted. I thought I played well in the final. It’s been a massive journey with so many ups and downs. I think it’s been well documented that I think I’ve underachieved in my career but you’ve got to enjoy this moment.

“It was a strong field this week and I felt like I played the best snooker and deserved to win the tournament. Jimmy White texted me this morning and so did Ken Doherty – we are all great friends and players get behind each other. Only one person can win and this was my week.”

![Image 15: Ken Doherty kisses the trophy in a snooker competition while a woman in the background applauds](https://wpbsa.com/wp-content/uploads/NZ9_0362-300x200.jpg)

JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship 2025 – How To Follow
===================================================================

9th May 2025

[Home](https://wpbsa.com/) » JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship 2025 – How To Follow

**Snooker returns to the Crucible Theatre on 7-11 May 2025 as the JenningsBet World Seniors Snooker Championship takes place at the sport’s most iconic venue.**

*   [Draw](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025/knockout)
*   [Schedule](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025/schedule)
*   [Results](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025/results)
*   [Player List](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025/players)

Igor Figueiredo is the defending champion in an international field of 16 players from nine nations including Jimmy White, Ken Doherty and more.

The Championship can be watched live on Channel 5 and 5Action in the UK and you can also follow the event via [WPBSA SnookerScores](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025).

**[Learn more about World Seniors Snooker](https://snookerscores.net/tournament-manager/jennings-bet-world-seniors-championship-2025).**

北京时间5月9日凌晨5时46分，2025斯诺克元老世锦赛在克鲁斯堡剧院结束了首轮16进8轮次两个比赛日的争夺，赛会八强悉数产生，1/4决赛对阵出炉。

传奇球员六届世亚、四届元老赛冠军吉米·怀特、前世冠肯·达赫迪，刚刚退役的两位排名赛冠军多米尼克·戴尔、乔·佩里，卫冕冠军巴西球员伊戈尔·菲格雷多、上世纪八十年代初的排名赛两冠王、69岁的托尼·诺尔斯等报名参加了本届元老世锦赛。

首个比赛日，卫冕冠军巴西球员伊戈尔·菲格雷多2-4不敌英格兰民间高手韦恩·汤森，遭遇一轮游；两位刚刚退役的排名赛冠军多米尼克·戴尔和乔·佩里双双以4-2获胜，来自英国王权地泽西岛的2018年元老世锦赛冠军亚伦·卡纳万4-1碾压混了10来年职业、一事无成的安德鲁·诺曼。

**元老世锦赛的第二比赛日赛况战报**

吉米·怀特1-4不敌阿尔菲·博登；

肯·达赫迪2-4不敌来自南非的无名之辈查尔·琼克；

两位传奇、也是赛会的两大夺冠热门双双止步首轮。

即将年满60岁的97年国际公开赛亚军托尼·德拉高，以4-3力克51岁的杰拉德·格林，挺进次轮；

澳大利亚乡间草民哈桑·克德，以4-0羞辱老迈的排名赛冠军托尼·诺尔斯

**斯诺克元老世锦赛（World Seniors Championship）**是为高龄职业或退役球员设置的赛事，面向40岁以上且世界排名前64以外的球员，包括全世界的业余球手，首轮直至半决赛都采用7局4胜制，决赛为9局5胜。

冠军奖金约1.5万英镑，另外单杆最高分还有1500镑奖金，不过冠军最大的福利是可获得下赛季冠中冠的资格，只要参赛，即使首轮出局也会有12500英镑的出场费可拿。

斯诺克元老世锦赛为那些传奇老将提供了重返克鲁斯堡剧院的机会，吉米·怀特就曾四度夺冠，弥补了他六次世锦赛亚军的遗憾。

而马克·威廉姆斯曾在2015年拿到元老世锦赛冠军，之后又在2018年第三次赢得世锦赛冠军，是斯诺克史上唯一一位拿过元老赛冠军再拿世锦赛冠军的球员。

**接下来的1/4决赛**

2018年元老赛冠军、泽西岛的亚伦·卡纳万，是唯一的前赛事冠军，不过乔·佩里和下一轮就将德比战遭遇的太空人多米尼克·戴尔是夺冠赔率最高的两位了。

**The 2024 World Seniors Championship takes place at The Crucible, and you can follow the latest results and schedule of play here.**

The 15th edition of the tournament features 16 players aged over 40 competing at the sport’s spiritual home in Sheffield.

This year’s field includes two former World Champions, as well as a host of former ranking event winners and qualifiers, as they compete for the title from May 8-12.

Jimmy White is the defending champion after he defeated Alfie Burden 5-3 in last year’s final to claim the crown for the fourth time.

White is the number one seed in the draw and is joined by 1997 World Champion Ken Doherty and 1986 World Champion Joe Johnson.

The likes of Tony Drago, Tony Knowles, Darren Morgan and Dechawat Poomjaeng also feature, as well as Brazil’s Igor Figueiredo and Thai legend James Wattana.

A notable change to this year’s format sees the introduction of a 30-second shot clock.

First Round and Quarter-Final matches are to be contested over the best of five frames, while Semi-Finals are best of seven and the final best of nine.

图片：斯诺克“元老世锦赛”奖杯，象征荣耀与坚持的象征。

2025年“斯诺克元老世锦赛”即将拉开帷幕，比赛将在英国谢菲尔德著名的“克鲁斯堡剧院”举行，与去年结束的年度斯诺克大师赛地点相同。自1991年首次举办以来，“元老世锦赛”经历了数十载沉淀，于2010年后逐渐恢复，目前已成为广受关注的老将盛事。英国斯诺克管理机构明确表示，将继续在“克鲁斯堡剧院”举办至2027年，与主赛事保持同步。这一传统由来已久，从1977年开始，克鲁斯堡剧院就成了斯诺克的重要舞台，每年的伟大比赛都在这里上演。

![Image 8: The trophy for the World Seniors Snooker Championship on a snooker table](https://q6.itc.cn/images01/20250508/430d49b7915243e582fe8da723038ee2.jpeg)

本届比赛参赛规则是年龄40岁以上且世界排名在前64名之外的球员。上一屆冠军由来自巴西的伊戈尔·费雷多捧得，他在决赛中以5-2战胜英国选手肯·达赫迪。此次共有16名老将参赛，其中包括退役多年的传奇球员乔·佩奇和多米尼克·戴尔。他们都曾获得排名赛冠军，有着超过30年的职业生涯。本次赛事还迎来了另一位传奇吉米·怀特，他目前是史上“元老世锦赛”冠军最多的球员，曾六次闯入世锦赛决赛，尽管未能全部夺冠。

![Image 9: A bald man, dressed in a white shirt and black waistcoat, is intently focused as he aims with a cue stick, his eyes fixed on the target, set against a blue backdrop](https://q6.itc.cn/images01/20250508/ce928ec1f4ab4746bb808f6a650903b3.jpeg)

不同于往年，本届赛事在局数设计上做出重大调整：首轮和四分之一决赛都实行7局4胜，半决赛提升至11局6胜，决赛则为15局8胜。这一变化旨在增加比赛激烈程度，让精彩瞬间层出不穷。虽然主办方尚未公布奖金细节，但根据近年来的惯例，冠军将收获2万英镑奖金，并获得参加重量级邀请赛“冠中冠”的资格，为球员提供进一步展示实力的平台。

首轮精彩对阵如下：

5月7日19:00——乔·佩里挑战安德森·鲁森；

5月7日21:00——多米尼克·戴尔迎战克雷格·斯特德曼；

5月8日02:00——伊戈尔·费雷多对阵韦恩·汤森；

5月8日04:00——亚伦·卡纳万VS安德鲁·诺曼。

**次日赛事安排：**

19:00——吉米·怀特对阵阿尔菲·博顿；

21:00——达赫迪迎战查尔·琼克；

2:00（9日）——托尼·德拉高对阵杰拉德·格林；

4:00（9日）——托尼·诺尔斯PK哈桑·克尔德。

现年50岁的佩里曾拥有两座排名赛冠军，此次重返赛场，令人期待他的表现。而多米尼克·戴尔，53岁，曾两次赢得排名赛冠军，也是在退役后依然保持竞技状态的代表人物。此外，2024年冠军伊戈尔·费雷多虽已转为业余身份，但在南美斯诺克界仍具极高声望。

![Image 10: A man in a navy waistcoat, striped bow tie and light shirt holding a trophy with a slight smile](https://q7.itc.cn/images01/20250508/eafe854dc52446328e88aa28fe2b90f6.jpeg)

回顾历届冠军，吉米·怀特无疑是最耀眼的名字之一，他不仅多次夺冠，还用长久的坚持彰显了老将的魅力。随着比赛临近，各路高手纷纷亮相，这场经典对决注定精彩纷呈。让我们共同期待2025“元老世锦赛”带来更多令人难忘的瞬间！[返回搜狐，查看更多](https://www.sohu.com/?strategyid=00001&spm=smpc.content-abroad.content.3.1766329465960l4PDAok "点击进入搜狐首页")
